description: A festival repertory curator must approve the final presentation package for a restored silent film in the festival retrospective, including the projection format, image framing, accompaniment, and production records.

shared_context.S1: The festival is presenting a restored silent film, "The Last Harbor," in its retrospective program.
shared_context.S2: The draft presentation package proposes a digital projection, a live string trio, and the standard 16:9 screen mask.
shared_context.S3: Mara makes the binding decision on the final presentation package.
shared_context.S4: Before the package is locked, Mara conducts the festival's routine archive, music, and technical check-in with the responsible staff.

PF1.text: Julian reviewed an archive-license amendment received yesterday confirming that this festival screening must use the Northlight Archive's 35mm print, retain the film's 1.33:1 image framing without cropping, and display the exact credit "Restored by Northlight Archive"; he has not entered the amendment into the festival rights tracker yet.

PF2.text: Nia tested the screening room with the live-score setup this morning and confirmed that the room's pit and monitoring arrangement supports only a solo piano, not the proposed string trio; the commissioned score cleared for this performance is "Tide Marks," and she has not yet updated the technical run sheet.

acceptance_conditions: The film must be presented using the Northlight Archive 35mm print.
The image must be framed at exactly 1.33:1 without cropping.
The accompaniment must be a solo piano performance.
The approved score must be "Tide Marks."
The exact restoration credit must be recorded.
An archive-rights commitment and a technical-run-sheet commitment must be logged.
Julian's archive-license amendment must be spoken aloud and cited by Mara.

content_checks.C1: decisions['projection_format'] in ['35mm', '35mm print', '35mm print from Northlight Archive', '35mm print (Northlight Archive)']
content_checks.C2: decisions['image_framing'] in ['1.33:1', '1.33:1 without cropping', '1.33:1 framing', '1.33:1 framing without cropping']
content_checks.C6: any(c.get('target') == 'Julian' and c.get('type') in ['archive_rights_record', 'rights_tracker_update', 'documentation', 'follow-up', 'administrative'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any(c.get('target') == 'Nia' and c.get('type') in ['technical_run_sheet_update', 'documentation', 'follow-up', 'technical'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The archive amendment changes projection from the draft digital package to a 35mm print, fixes the image framing at exactly 1.33:1 without cropping, replaces the generic credit with the exact Northlight Archive wording, and requires the amendment to be entered in the rights tracker.
The room test changes accompaniment from the proposed string trio to solo piano, identifies "Tide Marks" as the cleared score, and requires the technical run sheet to be updated.
